LHR.advice: If driving into central London, budget for the Congestion Charge and check your vehicle meets ULEZ standards, since simply parking (without driving) inside the zone does not itself incur either charge.

gem:portovenere.restricted_note: The historic centre is a narrow pedestrian core; all listed parking areas (P1-P3, Il Golfo) lie outside it at the approaches to town.

gem:portovenere.advice: Arrive early in high season (mid-March to mid-October) as the numbered lots fill quickly and the old town itself is not accessible to visitor cars.

SVQ.restricted_note: The Casco Antiguo (historic centre) has restricted-access zones requiring a permit, and a separate low emission zone (ZBE) covers the Cartuja district (Mon-Fri 7:00-19:00).
SVQ.advice: Driving into the Casco Antiguo requires a residents'-zone access permit, so visitors should use one of the AUSSA car parks ringing the historic centre instead.

PMO.restricted_note: Central Palermo has a ZTL (limited traffic zone) with access allowed only during set hours and with a permit/ticket.

gem:lucerne.advice: On-street blue-zone parking is limited to one hour with a parking disc, so use one of the signposted Parkhaus garages for a longer stay in the centre.

gem:annecy.advice: Free park-and-ride sites ring the city (Barral, Coubertin, Cap Periaz and others); leave the car there and walk or bus into the old town rather than hunting for paid on-street spaces.

gem:lake-district.advice: Carry coins as well as a card: many National Park Authority car parks are pay-and-display and some rural ones have no signal for card or RingGo payment.

gem:lago-maggiore.advice: Lago Maggiore is a lake shared by many separate comuni, and neither the Stresa municipality nor the local tourist office publishes a parking list, so check the individual town's own site before arriving.

gem:kromeriz.advice: The town has more than 900 paid parking spaces and new information panels guide drivers to free places, so follow the signs from Velké náměstí rather than circling the square.

gem:burg-eltz.advice: Navigate to "Burg Eltz, Wierschem", bring cash for the 4 euro parking fee, and either walk down or take the Pendelbus from Parkplatz 1, which runs every 10 minutes for 2 euros per person per trip.

gem:porto-vecchio-palombaggia.restricted_note: The commune operates a zone reglementee in the centre for which access authorisations have to be applied for at the mairie.

gem:porto-vecchio-palombaggia.advice: There are over 1 000 spaces in the numbered municipal car parks plus around 400 metered on-street spaces in the orange and red zones, and the free A Citadina electric shuttles link the car parks with the centre and the port.

car_parks.name: La Palud-sur-Verdon
car_parks.note: free; a field below the children's playground, main staging area for the Blanc-Martel trail

car_parks.name: Point Sublime

gem:gorges-du-verdon.advice: Park free in La Palud-sur-Verdon early in the morning and take the paid navette to Chalet de la Maline, and note the Route des Crêtes is one-way clockwise, closed roughly late November to late March and limited to vehicles 12 m long and 3.6

gem:la-roque-gageac.advice: All village parking is paid in season: the commune charges 3 euros for 2 hours up to 6 euros for 8 hours, payable by meter or the easypark app, free for motorcycles and for disabled drivers' vehicles.

gem:epidaurus.advice: There is an unnamed car park at the ancient theatre with, in the festival organiser's words, plenty of spaces for cars and coaches; neither the Ministry of Culture site page nor the festival page publishes fees or a car park name.

gem:cala-gonone.advice: Paid parking runs in Cala Gonone every day from Palm Sunday to 15 October, 08:00 to 13:00 and 15:00 to 20:00, at 0,50 euro per half hour and 1,00 euro per hour, collected for the Comune di Dorgali by SG Oikos Servizi.

gem:gaztelugatxe.advice: A free entry ticket must be obtained in advance to visit San Juan de Gaztelugatxe; the official Basque tourism pages describe only bus access (lines A3527 and A3518 from Bilbao and a Taxibus) and publish nothing about car parks.

car_parks.name: Plaza de Andalucía
car_parks.note: underground parking; the town hall handles licences for permanent spaces there

gem:ubeda.advice: Úbeda publishes almost nothing official about visitor parking; the tourist portal lists only a 10 space motorhome area at Travesía Comendador Messías with a two night maximum stay, so plan to park on the street outside the monumental quarte

gem:l-ametlla-de-mar.advice: From 15 June to 15 September parking is paid across some sixty streets of the town every day from 10:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 21:00, so use the Escoles Velles underground car park if you are staying more than a couple of hours.

gem:vila-nova-de-cerveira.restricted_note: Between 6 July and 6 September the historic centre is closed to through traffic by retractable bollards, covering Rua António José Duro, Terreiro, Praça da Liberdade as far as Rua do Cais, Rua Queiroz

car_parks.name: Parque da Praça da Galiza/Largo da Feira

gem:vila-nova-de-cerveira.advice: In July and August leave the car at the free Parque da Praça da Galiza/Largo da Feira and walk in, because the historic centre streets are bollarded off to all but residents, businesses, taxis and municipal vehicles.

car_parks.name: Parque Islas Canarias

ACE.advice: Arrecife's traffic ordinance allows time-limited regulated parking bays and pedestrian streets but the council publishes no list of car parks, so read the signs and the ticket machines on arrival.

RHO.restricted_note: A special entry permit is required to drive a vehicle inside the walls of the Medieval Town.

RHO.advice: Leave the car at the free Akantia parking by the old commercial port and take the free minibus, which runs every 20 minutes to the city hall.

WRO.advice: The city centre is a paid parking zone, 9:00 to 20:00 seven days a week in areas A and B, so it is cheaper to leave the car at a free Park and Ride and ride in on a tram.

car_parks.name: Bouillon

LUX.advice: City centre car parks such as Knuedler and Royal-Hamilius are paid, while the P+R sites at Bouillon and Kockelscheuer are free for the first 24 hours and connected to the centre by public transport.

ZAD.restricted_note: Parking on the old town peninsula is reserved for peninsula residents, everyone else may stay a maximum of one hour.

car_parks.name: Kolodvor

ZAD.advice: On-street parking is charged 8:00 to 22:00 Monday to Saturday and costs roughly double from mid-June to the end of August, so use a zone 2 lot or the station car park rather than driving onto the peninsula.

gem:ghent.restricted_note: Everything inside the R40 city ring is a low emission zone and the core has five car-free zones that can only be entered with a free digital permit.
gem:ghent.advice: Park free at one of the P+R sites on the edge of the city and take the tram or bus in, because the centre sits inside a low emission zone with car-free streets.

gem:rothenburg.restricted_note: The old town has a night driving ban from 19:00 to 6:00 and parking inside the walls is short stay and time limited.

gem:piran.restricted_note: The old town core is closed by physical barriers and only colour coded permit holders may drive in, with delivery vehicles allowed only between 6:00 and 9:30.

gem:taggia.advice: Si sosta sugli stalli blu pagando al parcometro 2,00 euro l'ora (1,00 euro per residenti e lavoratori), perche il centro storico e area pedonale con varchi.

gem:carrara.restricted_note: Il centro di Carrara e Zona a Traffico Limitato e contiene un'Area Pedonale Urbana accessibile solo ai veicoli autorizzati in determinate fasce orarie.

gem:lovere.advice: Il Comune non pubblica un elenco dei parcheggi, quindi conviene lasciare l'auto fuori dal centro storico, che e zona a traffico limitato.

gem:chioggia.restricted_note: Il centro storico di Chioggia e Zona a Traffico Limitato, attiva dalle 11.00 all'1.00 del giorno successivo dal 1 maggio al 30 settembre e dalle 11.00 alle 20.00 dal 1 ottobre al 30 aprile.
gem:chioggia.advice: La ZTL del centro storico scatta ogni giorno alle 11.00, quindi conviene arrivare prima o lasciare l'auto fuori dalla zona e proseguire a piedi.

gem:zonnebeke.advice: In de blauwe zones mag je maximaal 3 uur parkeren met parkeerschijf, van maandag tot en met zaterdag van 08.00 tot 18.30 uur.

gem:montegridolfo.restricted_note: Nel centro storico entro le mura vige il divieto assoluto di accesso e circolazione dalle 14.00 alle 8.00 del giorno successivo, salvo residenti e autorizzati.
gem:montegridolfo.advice: Arrivare tra le 8.00 e le 14.00 per sostare al massimo un'ora in Piazza Matteotti con disco orario, altrimenti lasciare l'auto fuori dalle mura e salire a piedi.

gem:lerici.advice: Leave the car outside the ZTL gates, pay the tariff on the white or blue street bays and use the two free navetta shuttle lines to reach the seafront.

gem:montagnana.advice: The comune publishes its parking map only as downloadable PDFs, so follow signage on arrival and leave the car outside the walled centre.

gem:alassio.restricted_note: The official tourist office states that some ZTL zones exist in Alassio and refers drivers to the municipal police for their extent.
gem:alassio.advice: Most parking is on-street in blue-lined bays at 1,80 euro per hour, payable at the meter by cash or card or through the Easypark, Paybyphone and Cicero apps.

gem:casole-d-elsa.restricted_note: The historic centre is a ZTL; the 2025 summer rules closed Via Aringhieri, Piazza Libertà, Via Casolani and Via Rivellino to unauthorised traffic daily from 20:00 to 24:00.
gem:casole-d-elsa.advice: Leave the car in one of the two car parks at the entrance to the village, because the centre is under ZTL control.

gem:cesena.restricted_note: The historic centre is a Zona a Traffico Limitato whose accesses are monitored by electronic gates at ten points, among them Piazza del Popolo, Corso Mazzini, Corso Garibaldi and Corso Sozzi.

gem:cesena.advice: Park in one of ATR's numbered car parks (P1 to P7) just outside the walls and walk in, since the centre itself is a camera-controlled ZTL.

gem:emden.advice: Central parking is chargeable at 1 Euro per hour in the red and green zones and 0,50 Euro per hour in the blue zone, but many central lots are free on Sundays and public holidays.

gem:orihuela.advice: Street parking in the centre is the regulated ORA zone, payable Monday to Friday 10:00 to 14:00 and 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday 10:00 to 14:00, with a maximum stay of two hours.

gem:choirokoitia.advice: Nothing official is published about parking here; the site sits beside the Lefkosia to Lemesos motorway, 32 km from Larnaka, and is open daily from 08:30 with a 2,50 Euro entrance fee.

gem:luanco.advice: Kerbside spaces on Calle Ateneo Obrero beside the town hall and bus station are limited to a two hour stay Monday to Saturday 10:00 to 20:00 during the summer season, so use Parque Zapardel for a longer visit.

gem:pardubice.advice: Paid street parking in the centre is split into zones A, B and C from 1 October 2025 at about 20 Kč per hour, so for a longer stay use the city-owned arena parking garage on the corner of Sukova and U Stadionu.

MXP.advice: Leave the car at an ATM car park beside a metro station outside Area B and take the metro in, rather than paying the Area C entry ticket and hunting for blue-line spaces.

BGY.restricted_note: Area C is an access-restricted charging zone covering the historic centre Monday to Friday 07:30 to 19:30, and the wider Area B bans polluting vehicles over the same hours.
BGY.advice: Leave the car at an ATM car park beside a metro station outside Area B and take the metro in, rather than paying the Area C entry ticket and hunting for blue-line spaces.

LIN.restricted_note: Area C is an access-restricted charging zone covering the historic centre Monday to Friday 07:30 to 19:30, and the wider Area B bans polluting vehicles over the same hours.
LIN.advice: Leave the car at an ATM car park beside a metro station outside Area B and take the metro in, rather than paying the Area C entry ticket and hunting for blue-line spaces.

MUC.restricted_note: The Umweltzone covers the Mittlerer Ring and everything inside it, a green Umweltplakette is required and diesel cars of Euro 4/IV and worse are banned until further notice.
MUC.advice: Check your car carries a green Umweltplakette before driving inside the Mittlerer Ring, and otherwise use a municipal P+R site, where a day of up to 24 hours currently costs about 1 to 2 euro.

gem:rotterdam.restricted_note: The zero-emission zone inside the ring applies only to vans and lorries, not to passenger cars.
gem:rotterdam.advice: City-centre garages all charge and rates differ per garage, so if you are going on by tram or metro use a P+R site instead, where several are free at all times.

car_parks.name: Parking de la place de la Rode
car_parks.note: 9h a 19h, 4 € les 4h, 5 € les 6h, 6 € les 8h, 25 € les 10h

car_parks.name: Parking de la rue du Repos
car_parks.note: 9h a 19h, 4 € les 3h, 5 € les 5h, 7 € les 8h, 25 € les 10h

car_parks.name: Parking du Pradal
car_parks.note: obligatoire pour les autobus et les camping-cars, ouvert 24 heures

car_parks.name: Parking St James
car_parks.note: 9h a 19h, 4 € les 4h, 5 € les 6h, 6 € les 8h, 25 € les 10h

car_parks.name: Parking du Jubilé
car_parks.note: réservé aux employés de l'hôpital, des commerces et des administrations

gem:domme.advice: Park in one of the paid car parks and walk up; buses and camping-cars are barred from the bastide and must use the Pradal, where the aire communale charges 25 € for 24 hours.

car_parks.name: parkeerterrein Nikadel
car_parks.note: blauwe zone; de ontheffing parkeerduurbeperking geldt hier niet

gem:de-koog.advice: Paid parking runs every day from 8.00 to 20.00 and needs a Texelvignet (€ 5 per hour, € 20 per day, € 30 per week); the village also has a blue zone where you need a parking disc.

gem:buitrago-del-lozoya.restricted_note: Está prohibida la circulación y estacionamiento en el interior del recinto amurallado a los no residentes.

car_parks.name: Parking Municipal Entrada por Calle Tahona y por Calle Real
car_parks.note: de 8:00h a 21:00h, uso exclusivo para turismos

car_parks.name: Plaza del Belén Viviente (antigua Plaza de los Hornos)

gem:buitrago-del-lozoya.advice: Non-residents may not drive or park inside the walls, so leave the car in one of the free parking areas around the old town and walk in.

gem:moraira.advice: Street parking in central Moraira is a paid zona azul run for the town hall, so take a ticket during the posted hours, which run Monday to Saturday 9.00 to 20.00 in July and August and shorter split hours the rest of the year.

gem:hoenderloo.advice: Most drivers here are heading for Nationaal Park De Hoge Veluwe, whose Ingang Hoenderloo is at Houtkampweg 13 and where park admission applies; nothing official is published about parking in the village itself.

gem:avallon.advice: The town states that all parking in Avallon is free, but the central zone bleue is capped at 1 hour 30 from Monday to Saturday 9.00 to 19.00 and needs a parking disc, which the Town Hall reception hands out.

gem:el-port-de-la-selva.advice: The council's traffic ordinance confirms a zona blava where a ticket is required, but no official list of car parks is published, so plan on hunting for street parking back from the seafront.

gem:luneville.advice: Every car park and on-street space in Lunéville is free, so the only thing to bring is a parking disc for the zones bleues, sold in supermarkets and tobacconists or given out at the Town Hall.

gem:loon-op-zand.advice: Parking in the centre of Loon op Zand village is free; the one hour parkeerschijf blue zone and the permit zones around the Efteling apply in Kaatsheuvel, not here.

car_parks.name: Walplantsoen
car_parks.note: free for 2 hours with a parkeerschijf

car_parks.name: de Haven
car_parks.note: free for 2 hours with a parkeerschijf

car_parks.name: Molen Rijn en Lek
car_parks.note: long stay, no parkeerschijf needed

gem:wijk-bij-duurstede.advice: Parking across the municipality is free, but the two terreinen nearest the centre are disc-limited to 2 hours, so leave the car at the Molen Rijn en Lek terrein if you are staying longer.

gem:boijl.advice: The municipality publishes nothing specific for Boijl and states that no parking permit is needed anywhere in Weststellingwerf, so village street parking is the only option.

car_parks.name: Søndre Molevej P-hus
car_parks.note: 10 kr per hour; the 2 hours free parking does not apply in the p-hus

car_parks.name: Kongsberg Allé
car_parks.note: 12 hours free parking

car_parks.name: Værftsvej
car_parks.note: free parking

car_parks.name: Toldbodvej
car_parks.note: first 2 hours free, then paid

car_parks.name: Køge Torv
car_parks.note: 2 hours free with a p-skive

gem:koge.advice: The town centre works on colour-coded zones where the first two hours are free on weekdays with a p-skive, so set the disc even where you pay nothing, and expect to pay from the first minute in the Søndre Molevej multi-storey.

gem:warten.advice: Warten appears nowhere in Leeuwarden's parking designation decision, which lists paid and permit places only in the city and a blue zone in Grou, so parking in the village is free and unregulated.

car_parks.name: Winkelcentrum Eisden
car_parks.note: paid; first 30 minutes free with a ticket, maximum 3 hours, 1 euro per hour or 20 euro per day

gem:eisden.advice: Eisden-dorp is a blue zone limited to 2 hours with a disc from Monday to Saturday 09.00 to 18.00, while the Winkelcentrum Eisden parking is paid, so bring a disc for the village and coins or the app for the shopping centre.

gem:heijen.advice: Nothing official is published about parking in Heijen itself; the municipality of Gennep issues no parking permits at all and its disc-controlled blue zone applies in Gennep town centre, not in the village.

car_parks.name: náměstí Míru
car_parks.note: first hour free, then 10 Kč, 20 Kč, 30 Kč, 40 Kč for the following hours, 100 Kč all day

gem:sobotka.advice: Parking on the main square náměstí Míru is regulated: take a zero-value ticket from the machine or set a parking disc showing your arrival time, since the first hour is free but must still be evidenced.

car_parks.name: P1 - République
car_parks.note: payant, 223 places

car_parks.name: P3 - Poincaré
car_parks.note: payant, 103 places

car_parks.name: P2 - Gambetta
car_parks.note: payant, 60 places, gestion privée

car_parks.name: P9 - Champ de Foire

car_parks.name: P6 - Michonette
car_parks.note: gratuit, 138 places

car_parks.name: P8 - Hôtel de Ville
car_parks.note: gratuit, 55 places

gem:toul.advice: Only three car parks in Toul are paid and even those are free from 12h to 14h, from 19h to 9h, on Saturday afternoons, Sundays and holidays, so the large free P9 Champ de Foire or P6 Michonette are the simplest option on arrival.

car_parks.name: Parrock Street ANPR car park
car_parks.note: pay on exit, charges Monday to Saturday 8am to 6pm including bank holidays

car_parks.name: Rathmore Road ANPR car park
car_parks.note: pay on exit, charges Monday to Saturday 8am to 6pm including bank holidays

car_parks.name: Milton Place ANPR car park
car_parks.note: pay on exit, charges Monday to Saturday 8am to 6pm including bank holidays

car_parks.name: West Street Pay & Display car park
car_parks.note: pay and display, coins or RingGo

car_parks.name: Ordnance Road Car Park
car_parks.note: RingGo payment only

gem:gravesend.advice: Use one of the council ANPR car parks and pay on exit, because on-street bays in the town centre are limited to two hours with no return for an hour and become permit holder only outside 8:00am to 6:30pm.

gem:haarlemmermeer.advice: Paid parking is confined to zones in Hoofddorp centre and around the station, Nieuw-Vennep station and Schiphol-Centrum, generally Monday to Saturday 09:00 to 18:00 plus Friday evening and Sunday afternoon, so parking elsewhere in the munic

gem:riva-del-garda.restricted_note: The historic centre is a ZTL (zona a traffico limitato) governed by mayoral ordinances, and entry requires a permanent or temporary permit.

car_parks.name: Terme Romane
car_parks.note: summer 2,00 euro/h 8-22, max 10 euro/day; winter 1,00 euro/h 8-20, max 7 euro/day

car_parks.name: Parco della Libertà
car_parks.note: summer 2,00 euro/h 8-22, max 10 euro/day; winter 1,00 euro/h 8-20, max 7 euro/day

car_parks.name: Ex-Agraria
car_parks.note: summer 2,00 euro/h 8-22, max 10 euro/day; winter 1,00 euro/h 8-20, max 7 euro/day

car_parks.name: Vecchia Stazione Nord
car_parks.note: summer 2,00 euro/h 8-22 and free 22-8, max 14 euro/day; winter 1,00 euro/h 8-20

car_parks.name: Parco Lido
car_parks.note: summer 4,00 euro/h around the clock; winter 2,00 euro/h weekdays, 4,00 euro/h Sundays and holidays

gem:riva-del-garda.advice: Leave the car in one of the automated APM car parks such as Terme Romane or Parco della Libertà and walk in, because the centro storico is a permit-only ZTL and the cheapest winter tariffs are roughly half the summer ones.

gem:colle-di-val-d-elsa.restricted_note: A ZTL has been in force in the Centro Storico Borgo since 1 May 2025, with transit and parking permits issued by the comune.

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Lo Spuntone - Via XXV Aprile

gem:colle-di-val-d-elsa.advice: Park below the old town, for example at La Fornacina - Porta Nova or Lo Spuntone, and walk up, since the Borgo in the historic centre has been a permit-only ZTL since May 2025.

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Interrato Piazza Claudio Villa
car_parks.note: paid parking under the new municipal management from 20 May 2025

gem:rocca-di-papa.advice: Paid parking now applies across the municipal area under a new operator, so use the underground car park at Piazza Claudio Villa and pay at the machine or by app.

gem:certaldo.restricted_note: Certaldo Alto, the walled upper town, is a camera-monitored ZTL closed to motor vehicles except authorised residents and businesses.

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Certaldo Alto
car_parks.note: about 40 spaces, 0,50 euro per hour

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Stazione F.S.
car_parks.note: about 100 spaces, paid

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Via XXVI Luglio
car_parks.note: free, about 50 spaces

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Via Leonardo da Vinci
car_parks.note: free, about 150 spaces

car_parks.name: Parcheggio di Viale Matteotti
car_parks.note: 37 car spaces, first 10 minutes free then 0,80 euro per hour

car_parks.name: Piazza Masini
car_parks.note: 0,80 euro per hour, minimum activation 0,40 euro

gem:certaldo.advice: Leave the car in the lower town and take the funicolare from piazza Boccaccio up to Certaldo Alto, which is closed to traffic.

PSA.restricted_note: The historic centre is a ZTL with an adjoining controlled parking zone (ZSC); since 1 January 2025 each permit is tied to a single number plate.

car_parks.name: Via Cammeo
car_parks.note: 350 spaces, open 24/7, first hour 3,50 euro

car_parks.name: Via Piave
car_parks.note: 120 spaces, open 24/7, first hour 3,50 euro

car_parks.name: Piazza Andrea del Sarto
car_parks.note: 183 spaces, 1,50 euro per hour, Monday to Saturday 8-20

car_parks.name: Palazzo dei Congressi
car_parks.note: 150 spaces, 0,75 euro per hour for non-residents, Monday to Saturday 8-20

car_parks.name: Via Paparelli (Mercato)
car_parks.note: 200 spaces, 1,00 euro per hour, market days

car_parks.name: Via A. da Morrona
car_parks.note: 93 spaces, 0,50 euro per hour, open 6-24 with charges 8-20

PSA.advice: Use the Via Cammeo structure just outside the walls and walk to Piazza dei Miracoli rather than driving into the ZTL.

MST.restricted_note: Since 1 January 2025 the binnenstad is a zero emission zone for vans and lorries below emission class 5; private cars are not affected.

car_parks.name: Entre Deux
car_parks.note: 25 euro per day

car_parks.name: De Colonel

car_parks.name: De Griend
car_parks.note: 18 euro per day

car_parks.name: Frontenpark
car_parks.note: 12 euro per day

MST.advice: P+R Maastricht Noord is free and continues into the centre on a low cost bus ticket, which beats the city centre garage day rates.

gem:baden-baden.advice: The municipal Parkgaragengesellschaft runs 1759 garage spaces in the Innenstadt plus 505 surface and 622 park and ride spaces, so head for one of its Parkhäuser rather than hunting for street parking.

car_parks.name: Grand Arcade car park
car_parks.note: open 24 hours; 3,70 GBP for up to 1 hour on weekdays, 33,50 GBP for over 5 hours

gem:cambridge.advice: City centre multi-storeys get expensive fast, so use one of the five Park and Ride sites on the ring road instead.

gem:zakopane.advice: Central Zakopane is a Śródmiejska Strefa Płatnego Parkowania charging seven days a week from 08:00 to 21:00, with subzone A at 5,00 zł and subzone B at 4,00 zł for the first 30 minutes.

gem:monemvasia.restricted_note: The surfaced road ends at the gates of the fortress town and visitors continue on foot up the lanes inside the walls.
gem:monemvasia.advice: Parking at the gates of the lower town is extremely limited, so leave the car in the new town of Gefyra and use the regular shuttle.

car_parks.name: Kronängsskolan
car_parks.note: free 1 September to 30 April, 10 kr per hour or 200 kr per day 1 May to 31 August

car_parks.name: Floravägen
car_parks.note: 10 kr per hour or 100 kr per day for the first 10 days, 1 June to 31 August, 30 day maximum

gem:vaxholm.advice: Central street parking costs 40 kr an hour from 1 May to 31 August, so use the Kronängsskolan lot, which is free from September to April.

car_parks.name: CMB Parking
car_parks.note: Saturday mornings, entrance on Rua do Ferraz

car_parks.name: Parque de estacionamento Saba Hospital de Braga
car_parks.note: 1,60 euro per hour

gem:braga.advice: Street parking around Praça do Comércio is a limited duration paid zone run by EUB, so for a longer visit use the Campo da Vinha or Central de Camionagem car parks.

gem:ostuni.restricted_note: The centro storico is a zona a traffico limitato where access is restricted for some or all vehicles and needs a permit.
gem:ostuni.advice: The comune publishes no named car parks for the old town, only permit based Zone a Rilevanza Urbanistica, so expect paid street parking below the white town and walk up.

gem:ascona.advice: Aim for the Autosilo Comunale at Viale Papio 8, a short walk from the lakefront, since the Posteggio Lungolago on Via Albarelle fills quickly.

car_parks.name: Parcarea Gondola
car_parks.note: 450 spaces, 30 lei per day for cars

car_parks.name: Parcarea Aleea Pelesului
car_parks.note: 30 spaces, 6 lei per hour or 30 lei per day

car_parks.name: Parcarea Furnica
car_parks.note: 22 spaces, 6 lei per hour or 30 lei per day

car_parks.name: Parcarea Ferdinand
car_parks.note: 73 spaces, 6 lei per hour or 30 lei per day

car_parks.name: Parcarea Octavian Goga
car_parks.note: 93 spaces, 6 lei per hour or 30 lei per day

car_parks.name: Parcarea Cuza Voda
car_parks.note: 61 spaces, 6 lei per hour or 30 lei per day

gem:sinaia.advice: For the cable car use Parcarea Gondola at 30 lei a day; the other municipal car parks charge about 6 lei an hour and are guarded during opening hours.

gem:rouen.restricted_note: Rouen is inside a Zone a Faibles Emissions where vehicles with a Crit'Air 4 or 5 sticker, or none at all, may not drive or park, and the historic core has a centre pietonnier.

car_parks.name: Palais de Justice, Musée des Beaux-arts

gem:rouen.advice: Carry a valid Crit'Air sticker, then leave the car in a parc relais such as Mont-Riboudet-Kindarena or in an underground car park like Hôtel de Ville and walk into the pedestrian core.

gem:bolzano.restricted_note: The historic centre is a zona a traffico limitato with camera-controlled electronic gates, and on-street spaces run on the municipal zone colorate permit system.

car_parks.name: Parcheggio BZ Centro
car_parks.note: open 0 to 24

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Palasport
car_parks.note: open 0 to 24

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Rosenbach
car_parks.note: short stay 06.00 to 23.00

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Wolff
car_parks.note: open 0 to 24

car_parks.name: Parcheggio Bolzano Sud
car_parks.note: free, near the A22 motorway exit

gem:bolzano.advice: Do not drive into the ZTL gates; use a SEAB garage such as Parcheggio BZ Centro, or park free at Parcheggio Bolzano Sud by the motorway exit.

car_parks.name: Centrální parkoviště
car_parks.note: at the Turistická chata entrance to Prachovské skály; parking fee is charged and is valid for the whole day

gem:bohemian-paradise.advice: Bohemian Paradise is a region with parking at each rock town entrance; at Prachovské skály use the central car park by the Turistická chata, where the daily parking fee is about 100 CZK for a car.

gem:karlstejn.restricted_note: The village is a pedestrian zone with a 20 km/h limit and a Zóna zákazu stání no-parking zone, so parking outside the central car park is strictly limited.

car_parks.name: Centrální parkoviště
car_parks.note: all day 200 CZK for a car, 400 CZK for a bus or caravan, 100 CZK for a motorcycle; first 10 minutes free

gem:karlstejn.advice: Use the central car park on the left bank of the Berounka, roughly 2 km from the castle, because it is the only public car park in the village.

gem:orava-castle.restricted_note: It is strictly forbidden to drive a car onto the main entrance road to the castle.

car_parks.name: Paid parking lot below the castle
car_parks.note: about 300 m from the Orava Castle ticket office

car_parks.name: Paid municipal parking lot
car_parks.note: about 300 m from the Orava Castle ticket office

gem:orava-castle.advice: Use one of the two paid car parks about 300 m from the ticket office, a four minute walk away, because the main entrance road to the castle is closed to cars.

car_parks.name: Oberer Parkplatz Burg Hohenzollern
car_parks.note: car park operates 09.30 to 17.30, tickets until 16.00

gem:hohenzollern-castle.advice: Park below the castle and take the shuttle bus from the stop next to the car park shop, since the fee for parking and the shuttle is already included in the castle ticket; walking up takes about 25 steep minutes.

car_parks.name: Schloss Laufen am Rheinfall
car_parks.note: CHF 5.00 up to 1 hour then CHF 2.00 per further hour for cars; free from 6 p.m. to 9 a.m. except P4

car_parks.name: P1/2
car_parks.note: short time parking in Neuhausen am Rheinfall; CHF 15.00 for a coach drop-off

car_parks.name: Burgunwiese
car_parks.note: coach parking free with a receipt from P1/2

gem:rhine-falls.advice: Choose your bank first: Schloss Laufen on the south side is the paid car park closest to the viewing platforms, while Schlössli Wörth and P1/2 serve the Neuhausen side.

car_parks.name: Parking Laubeuf (P3)
car_parks.note: currently closed for works

gem:cannes.advice: Use a CANNES Parking garage such as Palais or Suquet Forville near the old town; the first hour is free in the city's 17 car parks and the first half hour is free on street.

gem:porquerolles.restricted_note: Porquerolles is reached only by boat from La Tour Fondue on the Giens peninsula, and the Parc national says the Tour Fondue area saturates daily in summer.

car_parks.name: Parking Indigo

car_parks.name: Parking des îles
car_parks.note: payant, ouvert toute l'année

car_parks.name: Parking Porquerolles
car_parks.note: payant, ouvert du 1er avril au 5 novembre

car_parks.name: Almanarre
car_parks.note: gratuit

car_parks.name: Giens
car_parks.note: gratuit

gem:porquerolles.advice: Leave the car on the mainland at Giens and, in summer, use the free Arromanche relay car park with Réseau Mistral bus line 67 rather than driving to the saturated Tour Fondue car parks.

gem:collonges-la-rouge.restricted_note: The village has a restricted circulation period from 1 May to 31 August, during which the two car parks operate.

car_parks.name: Parking Chaulet
car_parks.note: environ 370 places, 3 euros du 1er février au 31 mars et 4 euros du 1er avril au 10 novembre, 30 premieres minutes gratu

car_parks.name: Parking Ecole
car_parks.note: environ 70 places, mêmes tarifs, gratuit de midi a 14h

gem:collonges-la-rouge.advice: Park at Chaulet or Ecole on the edge of the village: the first 30 minutes and the midday break are free, otherwise 3 to 4 euros depending on the season.

car_parks.name: Saint-Guirec

gem:ploumanach.advice: The car parks closest to the coastal path, Pors Kamor and Semaphore, are paid from late March to early November between 8am and 8pm, so use the free Ploumanac'h car park or the summer free shuttle from Saint-Guirec instead.

car_parks.name: Car park municipal square Corvara
car_parks.note: P2, Str. Col Alt, 0,50 euro per 15 minutes up to 8,00 euro for 12 hours, 8am to 8pm, parking prohibited midnight to 8am

car_parks.name: Car park market square Corvara
car_parks.note: P11, Str. La Siëia, 0,50 euro per 15 minutes up to 8,00 euro for 9 hours, 8am to 8pm, not allowed midnight to 6am on mar

gem:corvara-alta-badia.advice: Both central car parks are metered from 8am to 8pm at 0,50 euro per 15 minutes with a daily cap of 8 euro, and overnight parking is not allowed.

gem:merano.restricted_note: Merano has a zona a traffico limitato (ZTL) in the centre, for which the comune issues vehicle permits.

car_parks.name: Parking St. Josef
car_parks.note: 1,30 euro per half hour

car_parks.name: Parking Terme Merano
car_parks.note: 3,00 euro per hour

car_parks.name: Karl Wolf Parking
car_parks.note: 2,40 euro per hour, free for 15 minutes

car_parks.name: Plaza Parking
car_parks.note: 2,70 euro per hour

car_parks.note: 1,00 euro up to 3 hours, 1,60 euro over 3 hours

car_parks.name: Parking Prader Square
car_parks.note: free, not available on Fridays for the market and partly closed Tuesdays

gem:merano.advice: Central garages cost roughly 2,40 to 3,00 euro an hour and on-street bluepark is 2,50 euro an hour in zone A, so park at Meranarena or the free Prader Square lot and walk in.

gem:loen-nordfjord.advice: Visit Nordfjord states there are parking options in Loen centre, at Loen Skylift and at several points further into Lodalen, but no official car park names or tariffs are published.

gem:karpacz.advice: All the numbered municipal car parks charge 8 zl an hour or 40 zl a day, 24 hours a day, seven days a week, with 30 free minutes once a day at a few of them.

car_parks.note: June to September Mon-Thu 8h-22h, Fri-Sun 8h-2h; October to May Sun-Thu 8h-22h, Fri-Sat 8h-2h

gem:cascais.advice: Use one of the MobiCascais car parks, several of which are open 24 hours, and arrive early on event days because street space near the centre fills up.

gem:arouca.advice: Paid limited-duration parking, now capped at three hours, applies on ten streets in Arouca town, while parking at the Passadiços do Paiva entrances of Areinho and Espiunca is free but unsupervised.

gem:rabacal-25-fontes.restricted_note: The last 2 km of paved road down to the Rabacal forest house is not open to private cars, so drivers park up on the ER 105 (old ER 110).
gem:rabacal-25-fontes.advice: Park on the ER 105 (old ER 110) at the top and take the municipal van down to the Rabacal forest house, 5 euros one way or 8 euros return, every day from 10:00 to 18:00.

car_parks.name: Àrea de Serveis a Barruera
car_parks.note: motorhome service area with water discharge and refill

car_parks.name: Àrea d'aparcament del Pla de l'Ermita

gem:vall-de-boi.advice: Come in on the N-230 and the L-500; each Romanesque church has a car park at the entrance to its village, and Sant Climent de Taull has a large public car park on the right-hand side of the road.

gem:cap-de-formentor.restricted_note: From mid May to mid October the road out to Formentor is barriered daily from 10:00 to 22:00 and only authorised vehicles, buses, taxis, bicycles and emergency services may pass.
gem:cap-de-formentor.advice: In the restricted season take TIB bus line 334 from Alcudia or Port de Pollenca instead of driving, because the lighthouse road is barriered and the barrier at PK 2+000 also closes the beach road once its parking is full.

gem:eilean-donan.advice: The castle publishes only that disabled car parking is about 20 m from the main entrance, with no detail on general parking, so allow time at busy periods.

gem:veenhuizen.advice: Parking in Veenhuizen is free and spread over several spots in the village, and the gemeente parking disc zone applies only in the centre of Roden, not here.

gem:pontevedra.restricted_note: The historic centre takes destination traffic only, with entry and exit at the same point, a 10 km/h limit and pedestrian priority.
gem:pontevedra.advice: Leave the car in one of the roughly 3,500 free spaces on the ring around the centre, about ten minutes walk in, because the historic centre is open to destination traffic only.

gem:buxton.advice: Tariffs and hours are only shown on the signs at each car park, and machines take coins or card while every council car park also accepts the PayByPhone app.

gem:langemark.advice: Bring a parkeerschijf: the blue zone on the even numbered side of Langemarkstraat and the single short stay spaces outside shops are capped at 30 minutes, and staying longer without a disc costs 25 euro per calendar day.

gem:soko-banja.advice: The municipality has built a public car park but publishes no name, zone map or current tariff, and the free introductory period it announced ran only to 10 June 2025, so check the signs and the meter on arrival.

gem:mytikas.advice: The Dimos Xiromerou website carries no parking information for Mytikas, so expect unsigned village parking and arrive early in summer.

gem:ornans.advice: Central Ornans is covered by a permanent municipal zone bleue order, so carry a parking disc; Place Courbet and the Parking de la Plante, at the top of the lift, both have electric vehicle charging.

gem:constantina.advice: Neither the ayuntamiento nor the regional tourist board publishes any parking scheme for Constantina, so expect ordinary on-street parking in the town.
